sampling.calibration: 32 training records; up to32 stratified positions each; rank32 basis
sampling.historical: 32 positions total over native plus4 FIT; image/prompt/answer strata; first and final target predictors mandatory
sampling.native_pins: up to4 independent directions per qualified native source: first/final target predictors plus image/prompt representatives

storage.scope: protection tensors and counters; temporary extraction/SVD/model/optimizer memory excluded

diagnostics: sampled context and native uncovered normalized energy before/after admission
retained sketch and previous pinned direction coverage before/after compression
basis rank and sketch discarded energy
restore: new explicit version; legacy state rejected; pinned tensors/counters restored with shape/orthogonality/capacity validation
limitations: Stratified full-context sampling does not retain every token
Coverage measurements refer to sampled inputs and retained sketch, not all historical tokens
No live model or semantic retention validation
Fixed32 anchor bank supports current8-source scope only
